purpose: Test JEPA-style latent operator learning when the input physical field is only partially observed.
research_question: Can masked latent prediction learn an operator representation that is more robust to missing spatial observations than supervised field-to-field prediction with matched model capacity?
hypothesis: At 50% patch-wise missingness, a mask-to-predict JEPA pretraining stage followed by a fixed supervised operator head will reduce relative L2 solution error by at least 8% versus the same architecture trained from scratch.

data_contract.source: public/reproducible PDE datasets or deterministic local generation; exact source and hashes must be frozen before training
data_contract.leakage_rule: No target solution values from masked input regions may enter the candidate encoder during pretraining or evaluation.

candidate.encoder: shared spatial encoder over observed values + coordinates + binary observation mask
candidate.objective: predict target latent tokens for masked/unobserved regions from observed context tokens
candidate.predictor: lightweight latent transformer or MLP-mixer chosen before main run
candidate.downstream: freeze or partially freeze encoder according to a single predeclared policy; train matched operator head

baselines: same operator architecture trained from scratch on the supervised PDE objective
masked-input reconstruction pretraining with matched encoder capacity

metrics.primary: relative L2 field error at 50% random-patch missingness
secondary: relative L2 across all missingness regimes

success_gate.pass: At least 8% relative improvement over from-scratch baseline on the primary metric, with equal-or-better result on both PDE tasks or a clearly predeclared pooled analysis.
success_gate.strong_pass: Pass plus robustness improvement at 75% missingness without more than 10% inference-time overhead.
success_gate.fail: If the pass condition is not met, preserve the result as negative/inconclusive; do not retune the gate.

execution_order: verify dataset provenance and split hashes
freeze architecture/hyperparameter search outcome on validation only
emit raw records and machine-readable verdict
required_artifacts: configs for candidate and every baseline
related_2026_motivation: Recent latent-autoregressive neural-operator work reports substantial gains under partial observations; this protocol isolates whether JEPA-style masked latent pretraining itself contributes under a matched downstream operator budget.
